# Keswick Heating & Cooling

> Keswick Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Keswick, York Region, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 476-8231  |  Email: contact@keswickheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://keswickheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Keswick, Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Stouffville, King City
